title: Kuramanta pyramid built on geothermal hot spring

tellings.quote: For example, pyramid core manta in Japan. Building that pyramid on top of a geothermal hotring where there's natural heat energy and sulfur gas coming up into the structure

plain: A pyramid in Japan that he calls Kuramanta was built right on top of a hot spring, says the pyramid researcher Geoffrey Drumm, so that natural heat and sulfur gas rise up into the structure. Drumm gives it as an example without naming a source, as part of his argument that pyramids were placed on purpose to use energy coming out of the ground.
